title: n/2ⁿ and the ratio test
caption: The terms of Σ n/2ⁿ are ½, ½, ⅜, ¼, 5/32, … Each term divided by the one before is (n + 1)/(2n), which falls towards ½ and is below 1 from the second term on, so the terms shrink geometrically and the series converges (to 2).
alt: Five boxes ½, ½, ⅜, ¼, 5/32 with the ratios of consecutive terms 1, ¾, ⅔, ⅝ beneath.
description: The ratio of consecutive terms is (n + 1)/(2n).
It tends to ½ as n grows.
